settings.subtitle: Art prints made for long weekends & loud lines.

settings.heading: the story
settings.story:
friday prints began in Cairo on a quiet Friday night.

GiGi was created as a way to personify friends, their moods, quirks and adventures. Over time she became a character of her own, travelling through imagined worlds and collecting stories along the way.

Along the way she meets new friends, unexpected companions and curious characters, each bringing their own stories to the journey.

These prints are small fragments of that world.
